requirements.title: Checkout and Cart Workflow
requirements.description: PCI-compliant payment form, cart integration, and checkout workflow

requirements.title: Digital Wallet and Payment Method Support
requirements.description: Integration with Apple Pay, Google Pay, Samsung Pay, and PayPal Express Checkout for one-tap checkout and alternative payment methods

requirements.title: Performance and Scalability
requirements.description: Ensure checkout page loads within 2 seconds on 3G connections and support high volumes of transactions

requirements.title: Data Model and Entity Relationships
requirements.description: Design and implement the data model, including entities, fields, and relationships

requirements.title: Data Validation and Retention
requirements.description: Implement data validation rules and ensure data retention and archival requirements are met

requirements.title: API Gateway Architecture
requirements.description: Design and implementation of the API gateway, including authentication, versioning, and rate limiting

requirements.title: Webhook Delivery and Notification
requirements.description: Design and implementation of webhook delivery and notification system, including event publishing, logging, and retry mechanisms

requirements.title: Non-Functional Requirements
requirements.description: Definition of non-functional requirements, including performance, scalability, and availability, to ensure the system meets the required SLAs

requirements.title: Merchant Dashboard
requirements.description: The merchant dashboard provides real-time visibility into transaction volume, revenue, and disputes, with interactive charts, data export, and transaction management capabilities.

requirements.title: Transaction Management Workflow
requirements.description: Merchants can search, view, and manage transactions, with bulk actions and export capabilities.

requirements.title: Reporting and Analytics
requirements.description: Automated daily settlement reports, custom report builder, and revenue forecasting based on historical transaction patterns.

requirements.title: Observability and Monitoring
requirements.description: The system must provide comprehensive logging, tracing, and metrics for monitoring and incident response

requirements.title: Payment Gateway Architecture
requirements.description: The system follows a microservices architecture deployed on AWS EKS with core services, inter-service communication using gRPC with TLS 1.3 encryption, and databases for transactional data, session caching, and audit logs.

requirements.title: Payment Processing Workflow
requirements.description: The system handles credit card, debit card, digital wallet, and bank transfer payments, including tokenization, authorization, and settlement, with support for 3D Secure 2.0 and retry mechanisms.

requirements.title: Security and Compliance
requirements.description: The system ensures PCI-DSS compliance, encrypts cardholder data using AES-256 at rest and TLS 1.3 in transit, and implements rate limiting, access controls, and logging mechanisms.

requirements.title: Multi-Currency Support and Fraud Detection
requirements.description: The system supports transactions in multiple currencies, fetches exchange rates, and detects fraud using velocity, geolocation, device fingerprint, and transaction amount analysis.

requirements.title: Refund and Chargeback Management
requirements.description: The system supports full and partial refunds, processes refunds within 24 hours, and tracks chargeback cases with document upload capability.

requirements.title: Merchant Onboarding and Management
requirements.description: A system for merchant onboarding, including a wizard-based process for business information, KYC documents, bank details, and review and submission.

requirements.title: E-Commerce Payment Processing
requirements.description: Enable merchants to process payments via a secure and reliable payment gateway

requirements.title: Subscription and Recurring Billing Management
requirements.description: Support recurring billing and subscription lifecycle management, including automated charging, retry logic, and webhooks for subscription events

requirements.title: API and Integration
requirements.description: Provide a secure and well-documented API for merchants to integrate with the payment gateway, including webhooks for payment and subscription events
